item.title: Concert news: Diljit Dosanjh back at Rogers Place May 2, Boots and Hearts lineup update
item.description: Contemporary Punjabi singer and charismatic Bollywood star Diljit Dosanjh returns to Rogers Place May 2 in grand style, almost exactly two years after his last gigantic show here on the terrifically-named Dil-Luminati Tour. The 42-year-old was nominated for an International Emmy Award last year, while Vogue named him best dressed at the 2025 Met Gala. The Aura tour also continues from last year where he became the first Punjabi artist to headline and […]

item.title: Opinion: Threats against judicial independence weaken democracy
item.description: Recent comments by Alberta Premier Danielle Smith — particularly suggestions that judicial funding could be curtailed if her government doesn’t get more say in appointing judges — should concern every single Albertan, regardless of political affiliation. item.title: Concert news: The Black Keys bringing the blues to Rogers Place June 3 — how to get tickets
item.description: For any and all who love funk-driven-blues rock, The Black Keys will be unlocking their distinct groove at Rogers Place June. 3. Showing off the music from their brand-new album Peaches! releasing May 1 – including just-dropped single You Got to Lose – childhood friends and longtime jam buddies Dan Auerbach and Patrick Carney will be unleashing heartfelt songs like Lonely Boy, Tighten Up and I’ll Be Your Man, not to mention blues standards […]

item.title: Opinion: Planning for passenger rail is essential for Alberta
item.description: As Alberta’s Passenger Rail Master Plan nears completion, the province stands at an inflection point. With rapid population growth and mounting pressure on our highways, Alberta has a rare opportunity to reshape how people move — one that would expand transportation choice, support economic growth, and improve quality of life for communities across the province.
